title: Clean Investment-Grade Corporate Bond Addition
description: Routine purchase of $1.20M Microsoft Corp (AAA/Aaa) USD corporate bond. Brings single-issuer exposure from 3.10% to 4.30% (<= 5.00% limit).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Standard senior unsecured notes issued by Microsoft Corp.

ground_truth_rationale: Post-trade exposure to PAR-MSFT is $4.30M (4.30% of NAV <= 5.00%). Technology sector is 13.65% (<= 25.00%). Investment Grade.

title: Single-Issuer Concentration Hard Breach
description: Purchase of $1.25M Apple Inc (AA+/Aaa) USD bond. Existing position is $4.20M (4.20%); trade pushes post-trade exposure to $5.45M (5.45% > 5.00%).
ground_truth_rationale: Breaches Section 3.01(a): Post-trade exposure to Apple Inc reaches 5.45% of NAV ($5,450,000 / $100,000,000), exceeding the 5.00% Single-Issuer limit by 45 bps.

title: Parent-Subsidiary Affiliated Group Aggregation Trap
description: Purchase of $1.30M in Florida Power & Light Co (0% direct holding), a wholly-owned subsidiary of NextEra Energy Inc (PAR-NEE, already at $4.10M / 4.10% NAV).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: First mortgage bonds issued by Florida Power & Light Co, a wholly-owned operating subsidiary of NextEra Energy Inc.

ground_truth_rationale: Direct issuer ISS-FPL is only 1.30% of NAV, but under Section 1.04 and Section 3.01(b), aggregating by ultimate_parent_id (PAR-NEE) yields $4.10M + $1.30M = $5.40M (5.40% > 5.00%).

title: Split Credit Rating Governance (Higher Rating Governs)
description: Purchase of $1.50M Ford Motor Credit Co bond rated BBB- by S&P (Investment Grade) and Ba1 by Moody's (High Yield). Current High Yield bucket is 14.20% (cap 15.00%).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Split-rated senior notes: S&P BBB- (Investment Grade) / Moody's Ba1 (Non-Investment Grade).

ground_truth_rationale: If treated as High Yield, this $1.50M trade would push the High Yield bucket from 14.20% to 15.70% (breaching Section 2.01). However, under Section 2.02(b), the higher of the two split ratings (S&P BBB-) governs, classifying it as Investment Grade and leaving High Yield unchanged at 14.20%.

title: High-Yield Energy Sector Sub-Cap Breach
description: Purchase of $700K Permian Resources (BB/Ba2) High-Yield Energy bond. Total High Yield moves from 14.20% to 14.90% (<= 15.00% overall cap), but High-Yield Energy moves from 4.50% to 5.20% (> 5.00% sub-cap).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Senior notes issued by independent oil & gas exploration company.

ground_truth_rationale: Passes Section 2.01 (Total High Yield = 14.90% <= 15.00%), but breaches Section 3.02(b): High-Yield Energy holdings ($3.10M OXY + $1.40M CHK + $0.70M PR = $5.20M, or 5.20% of NAV) exceed the 5.00% High-Yield Energy Sub-Cap.

title: Unhedged Non-USD Debt — Eligible OECD Sovereign Carve-Out
description: Purchase of $1.20M unhedged UK Gilt (GBP Sovereign Bond, OECD Member). Existing unhedged OECD sovereign debt is $7.50M ($3.50M JGB + $4.00M Bund).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Direct sovereign obligation of the United Kingdom (OECD Member State), unhedged GBP exposure.

ground_truth_rationale: Qualifies for the Section 4.01(b) Eligible OECD Sovereign Carve-Out: UK is an OECD member, asset_class is SOVEREIGN_BOND, and post-trade unhedged non-USD sovereign exposure is $8.70M (8.70% <= 10.00% cap).

title: Unhedged Non-USD Corporate Bond in OECD Country (Carve-Out Misapplication Trap)
description: Purchase of $1.00M unhedged EUR corporate bond issued by Siemens AG (Germany, OECD member). Tests if the system confuses OECD corporate debt with OECD sovereign debt.

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Senior EUR-denominated corporate notes issued by Siemens, unhedged.

ground_truth_rationale: Breaches Section 4.01(a): Even though Germany is an OECD member, the Section 4.01(b) unhedged FX carve-out applies strictly to direct sovereign obligations (SOVEREIGN_BOND), not corporate bonds (CORPORATE_BOND).

title: Passive Market-Drift Cure vs. Incremental Active Purchase Prohibition
description: Purchase of $50,000 NVIDIA Corp equity. NVIDIA currently sits at $5.15M (5.15% NAV) due to passive market appreciation (permitted to hold under Section 3.03, but banned from any active BUY).

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Small add-on equity purchase in NVIDIA Corp.

ground_truth_rationale: Breaches Section 3.03 & Section 3.01(a): While Section 3.03 allows holding existing positions that drifted above 5.00% passively ($5.15M / 5.15%), it strictly prohibits any incremental active BUY order while exposure exceeds 5.00%.

title: [Edge Case / AI Failure Mode 1] Qualitative ESG Ambiguity ('Substantially Dependent' Freight Clause)
description: Purchase of $1.00M Heartland Rail & Bulk Logistics Corp bond. Direct thermal coal extraction revenue is 4.2% (<= 10.0% hard cap), but prospectus note discloses 22% revenue from 'mixed bulk mineral & coal rail corridors without commodity-level breakdown'.

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Issuer derives 4.2% of revenue from legacy coal mining royalties and 22.0% of gross revenue from dedicated Powder River Basin bulk rail freight corridors transporting coal, iron ore, and grain (exact coal freight split undisclosed).

ground_truth_rationale: Passes the hard 10% thermal coal extraction rule in Section 5.01(a) (4.2% <= 10.0%), but triggers qualitative ambiguity under Section 5.01(b) ('substantially dependent on dedicated thermal coal transport... as determined by the Compliance Committee'). Must escalate to Human Compliance Review rather than auto-approving.

title: [Edge Case / AI Failure Mode 2] Orphan SPV Credit-Linked Note Look-Through Blindspot
description: Purchase of $1.50M Cayman Emerald Trust 2026-1 Credit-Linked Note (STRUCTURED_NOTE_SPV). Structured columns show Cayman/OECD-compliant trustee and 0% parent concentration, but prospectus text reveals the note references a basket of third-party emerging market sovereign & energy credits.

proposed_trade.prospectus_supplement_notes: Series 2026-1 Credit-Linked Notes issued by an orphan Cayman SPV. Principal repayment is synthetically linked via total return swap to an undisclosed reference basket of Eurasian oil & gas transport entities.

ground_truth_rationale: Under Section 5.02, pass-through SPVs and Credit-Linked Notes without transparent look-through reference data in the security master cannot be auto-approved by structured column checks alone and must be escalated to Human Compliance Review.
